newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian has operation to remove knife from brain.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian has operation to remove knife from brain.

text.p: A Brazilian man underwent a successful nine-hour operation to remove a knife lodged in his brain since a bar brawl, Globo television said on Friday.
Construction worker Sidney de Queiroz has been paralysed on the right side of his body since he was stabbed in a fight over a $5 debt two weeks ago.

Doctors had to cut open the man's skull and remove the blade with special tweezers. X-ray images showed the five-inch (13 cm) blade completely buried between Queoroz's right eye and the bridge of his nose, just two millimetres from the main arteries that supply blood to the brain.
"No artery was cut in the operation -- that was the greatest worry," neurologist Luiz Alcides Manreza told Globo.
Queiroz was expected to be released in two weeks. Before the operation, he had told doctors he wanted everything to be done as quickly as possible so he could get back to work.
